text: Election of the Vice Chair of Toronto Parking Authority Board under the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, Balloting Procedures, for a term of office ending June 18, 2021, and until a successor is appointed.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Elected Namby Vithiananthan as Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority for a term of office starting July 23, 2019 and ending June 18, 2021, and until a successor is appointed.
